recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core change is recommended unless a future work group decision revisits ValueSet summary or metadata-only semantics.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary issue asking to clarify that a ValueSet resource can have neither .compose nor .expansion, and to distinguish metadata-only, definition-only, expansion-only, and combined retrieval/use forms.
initial_application: The Jira implementation comment identifies git 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249, which included GF#18677 and changed source/valueset/valueset-introduction.xml to say a ValueSet can carry .compose, .expansion, both, or neither if only metadata is represented. The same source area had already been changed by FHIR-17475 / commit 37b0ae652bb936957e6a8ccbecdcc8a17e97d6e4, which removed VSD-5 and added the combinations section.
additional_context: ValueSet is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Current ValueSet.compose and ValueSet.expansion are both optional in the StructureDefinition source, and current narrative explicitly lists the neither-compose-nor-expansion form as valid, primarily for summary search. Seed-specific Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting records; the related FHIR-17475 Jira and Zulip thread support the same metadata-only interpretation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already contains the clarification requested by FHIR-18677 and no remaining core source edit is needed.

related_jiras.note: Removed the old VSD-5 invariant and added the combinations guidance that now provides detailed use-case text for metadata-only ValueSet instances.
